Residual analysis for identified models

Source: R/identification.R
ctrl_resid.Rd

Compute the residuals of a model on data (one-step prediction errors for ARX models, output errors otherwise) and test them: the autocorrelation should be within the 99 percent band \(\pm 2.58/\sqrt{N}\) for white residuals (Ljung-Box test reported), and the cross-correlation with the input should vanish at nonnegative lags (residuals independent of current and past inputs; ccf reports \(\mathrm{cor}(e_{t+k}, u_t)\)). All outputs and input-output pairs are tested. Output-error models are not expected to have white residuals; the cross-correlation test is the relevant one for them.

Usage

ctrl_resid(model, data, lags = 20L)

Arguments

model

An identified model.

data

Data (preferably validation data).

lags

Maximum lag.

Value

A list of class ctrl_resid with residuals, acf, ccf (data frames with output, input, lag, value and band), ljung_box (p-value per output) and flags white and independent.

Examples

set.seed(1)
u <- rnorm(300)
y <- as.numeric(stats::filter(0.5 * c(0, u[-300]), 0.8, "recursive")) +
  rnorm(300, sd = 0.05)
d <- ctrl_iddata(y, u)
r <- ctrl_resid(ctrl_arx(d, 1, 1, 1), d)
r$white
#> [1] FALSE
